title: How Alignment Routes: Localizing, Scaling, and Controlling Policy Circuits in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model refusal rates, output steering behaviors, and internal circuit activations using a corpus of paired prompts across 15 categories of Chinese political sensitivity (e.g., Tiananmen Square, Tibet, Xinjiang), compared against matched control prompts on non-sensitive geopolitical topics.

Comparing internal model gate-layer activations between Chinese-language prompts and their English equivalents for the same politically sensitive content to observe differences in censorship routing triggers.
